Name: CSS' From Grandpa With Love - An Event Mod
Author: ClairesStoryofSeasons
Description:
﻿Do you ever wish to see more of Grandpa in your journey in the Valley beyond your Y3's evaluation score and the Mastery Cave? Do you feel as if most of your in-game achievements are left uncredited and unnoticed? Or, do you just yearn for an event mod that allows you to be more connected with Grandpa? 

I did, and if you do too, then this mod might just be for [i]you[/i].

[quote][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][i]﻿When life grows heavy, know that these letters are my way of staying close. And when your heart calls for it, read these letters. So you never have to wonder if you are alone.[/i][/font][/quote]
[b][color=#ffe599][font=Trebuchet MS]From Grandpa, With Love[/font][/color][/b] is an event mod that allows your farmer to read letters prepared by Grandpa before his passing. Tied to some of your in-game milestones and achievements, each one of these letters is contained in a series of cutscenes as if Grandpa is speaking to you himself. These letters are meant to guide you, encourage you, and show you that Grandpa has [i]always [/i]believed in you.

Ultimately, this mod hopes to give you some moments of reflection and, hopefully, warm your heart like it did mine. [img]https://i.postimg.cc/D07qL5vs/hearts.png[/img]

[font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#f4f4f4]Disclaimer[/color][/b][color=#999999]:[/color][/font] Do note that this is a [u]milestone-driven event mod [/u]where [i]cutscenes gradually unlock as your farmer progresses through the game[/i]. This mod is best played on a new save (for immersion purposes), but can still be used with mid-to-late-game saves. The mod also features some dialogue from a few townsfolk once the player chooses and finishes the CC route.
[line]
[size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#f1c232]WHAT TO EXPECT[/color][/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*]Expect a visit from Mayor Lewis, who has been holding onto a collection of handwritten letters from Grandpa. [/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Once you've reached specific in-game milestones, returning to your [u][b]farmhouse at 7 PM or later (on a non-festival day)[/b][/u] will trigger an event prompt: "read" the letters now, or save them for another time. Don't fret if you're not ready to view these letters, as they will remain available to you, and the prompt will be triggered the following day until you choose to "read" them. After viewing each cutscene, the letters are yours to read again in your Collections (Letters) tab.[/*]
[/list][code][spoiler] Currently, there are five achievements + 2 intro event with its own dedicated cutscenes:

In no particular order, the achievements are as follows: Completing the Community Center, Fullhouse (Married with 2 Kids), Receiving the Millionaire Achievement, Polyculture, and Reaching Level 120 of the Regular Mines.[/spoiler][/code][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][color=#f4f4f4]
Disclaimer for mid-to late-game p[/color]layers[/font][/b]: If you're worried that this mod might spam you with events running continuously (due to multiple achievements in your current save), know that the event was coded in a way to space out events from occurring in the same night. Under the circumstances that it occurs, you may choose to just save the letter for another time.

[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]For users who installed this on a fresh new save:[/font][/b] The first event does not get triggered until you've played[i] [/i][b]at least 14 in-game days [/b](or until the 14th of Spring of Y1)[i]. [/i]
[line]
[color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/font][/size][/color]

[b]Download[/b] the ZIP file and [b]extract [/b]its contents into your Mods folder. Manual installation of this mod is recommended. Make sure all required files are installed. 

[b]Note[/b]: FGWL requires Content Patcher 2.7.0 or higher versions. For other issues, please make sure to include your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] (and any relevant information) so that I may know how to address your problem.
[line]

[color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ffe599]Is this compatible with SVE, RSV, or any expansion in general?[/color][/b] - [u]Yes[/u]. Frankly, I don't see why not. The events will only transpire on the farm and in the farmhouse (7 pm onwards, non-festival). The only incompatibility I can imagine the mod would have is if you have a mod that substantially alters Grandpa's lore.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][i][b][color=#ffe599]"I already achieved the XYZ milestone? Why is the event prompt not showing up when I arrive at my farmhouse at night?"[/color][/b][/i] - In case you've already "read" certain letters, the mod is designed to space out other cutscenes on different nights. As long as the conditions are met and you return to your farmhouse at 7 pm (on a non-festival day), they're bound to trigger eventually. I intended the mod to be story-driven and do not want to overwhelm the farmer with events left and right. [/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b][color=#ffe599]Does this mod work on mobile?[/color][/b] - As far as I know, it does. Do note that I have not tested mobile compatibility personally, but it seems to have worked for some android modders.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#f1c232]﻿FUTURE PLANS[/color][/b][/font][/size]

I am quite content with the achievements I've set for this mod for storytelling purposes, but eventually, I might add a perfection cutscene for your farmer in the future (good luck to my mod users who have chronic restartitis!).

Feel free to share your suggestions. Stay tuned! 

In the meantime, you can check out my other works here:

[list]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35038]Harvey Cares[/url]﻿﻿ - A Harvey Marriage Expansion[/*]
[/list][line]

[line]

[size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#f1c232]CREDITS & AUTHOR'S NOTES[/color][/b][/font][/size]

Hi there! [img]https://i.postimg.cc/D07qL5vs/hearts.png[/img] Before anything else, I'd like to express my appreciation towards several people. A huge shoutout to my friends [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/rokugin?gameId=1303]Roku[/url], who listened to me rant about this mod while also guiding me to the right direction, and to Nox, who had affirmed the sentiment of my creation, lent an extra pair of eyes with grammar, and took the time to point out this mod's bugs. [img]https://i.postimg.cc/D07qL5vs/hearts.png[/img]

I'd also like to extend my appreciation to my friends from TC, fellow cheetos from the Stardew Valley Discord (s/o Si and Lyoko), and my peers from SMC who have literally been as supportive and encouraging as ever -- from the moment the idea took off until its completion.

[list]
[*]For ver. 1.1.1, a shout-out to[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/abagaianye] Aba[/url]﻿ for helping me out with fixing Grandpa's portrait bugs [img]https://i.postimg.cc/D07qL5vs/hearts.png[/img][/*]
[/list]
On a [i]more personal note[/i], this mod is a tribute to my own grandfather, who sadly passed away in September of 2023. Just like SDV's Grandpa, my grandpa in real life was also a farmer by trade who taught me the value of life, land, and nature at a young age. After my grandfather's passing two years ago, I found some semblance of solace in Stardew Valley. 

I owe a huge chunk of who I am and what I've achieved in life because of my grandfather and his support. FGWL is my way of expressing grief and honoring my [i]lolo[/i], whom I will perpetually hold close to my heart.
